a.q: The strong wind blew lots of snow down the steep mountain slope very quickly.
a.explain: avalanche — qor koʻchkisi: togʻdan tez tushadigan qor uyumi.

a.q: There is a very large advertising board near the central station showing a new phone.
a.explain: billboard — reklama taxtasi: koʻchada reklama uchun katta panel.

a.q: People are worried because the long summer without rain is destroying all their wheat crops.
a.explain: drought — qurgʻoqchilik: uzoq vaqt yomgʻir yogʻmasligi tufayli suv yetishmasligi.

a.q: The ground started shaking violently during the night and plates fell from our kitchen shelves.
a.explain: earthquake — zilzila: yer qobigʻining toʻsatdan silkinishi.

a.q: Many houses near the river were destroyed after the heavy rains caused water to rise everywhere.
a.explain: flood — suv toshqini: daryo suvining qirgʻoqdan toshib chiqishi.

a.q: A dangerous wall of fire moved rapidly through the dry trees in our national park.
a.explain: forest fire — oʻrmon yongʻini: oʻrmonda tez tarqaladigan xavfli olov.

a.q: Coal and oil are burned in factories every day, creating huge amounts of dirty black smoke.
a.explain: fossil fuels — qazilma yoqilgʻi: koʻmir, neft va gaz kabi tabiiy yoqilgʻilar.

a.q: My fingers became extremely cold and numb because I forgot to wear gloves outside today.
a.explain: frostbite — sovuq urishi: sovuqdan tananing muzlab qolishi.

a.q: Factories release harmful chemical vapors into the sky, trapping heat around our planet Earth.
a.explain: greenhouse gases — issiqxona gazlari: havo haroratini oshiruvchi zararli gazlar.

a.q: Hard little balls of ice fell from the dark sky and broke some garden flowers.
a.explain: hail — doʻl: muz parchasi shaklidagi yogʻingarchilik.

a.q: The bright yellow star in the sky made the school playground feel very warm today.
a.explain: sunshine — quyosh nuri: quyoshdan tushadigan yorugʻlik va issiqlik.

a.q: Thick white fog touched the ground near the lake this morning, making driving difficult.
a.explain: mist — tuman: yerdan koʻtarilgan yengil tuman.

a.q: Heavy rain on the steep hill caused tons of wet earth to slide down the road.
a.explain: mudslide — sel yoki loy koʻchkisi: togʻdan oqib tushuvchi loy.

a.q: People walked safely on the concrete path next to the busy city street this afternoon.
a.explain: pavement — piyodalar yoʻlagi: koʻcha chetidagi yurish uchun qism.

a.q: Children crossed the busy street safely using the white stripes painted on the road.
a.explain: pedestrian crossing — piyodalar oʻtish joyi: zebrali yoʻl qismi.

a.q: Small drops of water fell from the gray clouds, making my jacket slightly wet outside.
a.explain: rain shower — qisqa muddatli yomgʻir: tez oʻtib ketadigan yomgʻir.

a.q: Huge green forests near the equator receive heavy rainfall and have many unique animal species.
a.explain: rainforests — tropik oʻrmonlar: seryogʻin va issiq iqlimli yirik oʻrmonlar.

a.q: Solar panels and wind turbines provide clean power without harming the natural environment.
a.explain: renewable energy — qayta tiklanadigan energiya: tabiatga zarar bermaydigan quvvat manbai.

a.q: Drivers slowed down when they saw the blue circular sign showing the speed limit.
a.explain: road sign — yoʻl belgisi: haydovchilar uchun qoidani koʻrsatuvchi belgi.

a.q: Workers used heavy machines to repair the broken water pipes under the main street.
a.explain: road works — yoʻl taʼmirlash ishlari: koʻchadagi qurilish va taʼmirlash.

a.q: Water heights in the oceans are rising every year because polar ice is melting fast.
a.explain: sea levels — dengiz sathi: okean suvining oʻrtacha balandligi.

a.q: The bright sun shone in the clear blue sky while we played football outside.
a.explain: shine — porlamoq: yorugʻlik tarqatmoq, charaqlamoq.

a.q: We stood under the metal shelter waiting for the number 12 city bus to arrive.
a.explain: bus stop — avtobus bekati: jamoat transporti toʻxtash joyi.

a.q: Dark gray clouds covered the sky all morning and it started pouring rain quickly.
a.explain: storm — boʻron: kuchli shamol va yogʻingarchilik bilan keladigan ob-havo.

a.q: The intersection where two busy streets meet in our neighborhood has a small cafe.
a.explain: street corner — koʻcha burchagi: ikki koʻchaning tutashgan joyi.

a.q: Global measurements show that the average heat of the planet is increasing every decade.
a.explain: surface temperature — sirt harorati: yer yuzasining oʻrtacha issiqlik darajasi.

a.q: A bright flash of electricity lit up the dark night sky before a loud crash.
a.explain: lightning — momaqaldiroq chaqishi: osmondagi yorugʻ elektr toki chaqnashi.

a.q: A very loud booming sound shook our windows during the terrible rainstorm last night.
a.explain: thunder — momaqaldiroq gumburlashi: chaqmoqdan keyingi ovoz.

a.q: A huge wave caused by an underwater earthquake hit the coastal town without warning.
a.explain: tsunami — tsunami: okeandagi kuchli zilzila keltirib chiqaradigan ulkan toʻlqin.

a.q: Hot liquid rock and dangerous gas poured down the sides of the tall mountain.
a.explain: volcanic eruption — vulqon otilishi: vulqondan lava va gaz chiqishi.

a.q: Scientists need to think of a clever solution to solve the plastic waste problem.
a.explain: come up with — oʻylab topmoq: yangi goya yoki yechim topmoq.

a.q: The old factory near the railway had to stop operating because it lost money.
a.explain: close down — yopilmoq: korxona yoki doʻkon faoliyatini toʻxtatmoq.

a.q: Loggers use heavy axes to drop large trees in the forest for building materials.
a.explain: cut down — kesib tashlamoq: daraxt yoki boshqa narsani kesmoq.

a.q: Dinosaurs disappeared from the Earth millions of years ago after a massive space rock hit.
a.explain: die out — qirilib ketmoq: tur sifatida butunlay yoʻq boʻlib ketmoq.

a.q: The kitchen stove began to warm the soup until it started boiling in the pan.
a.explain: heat up — qizitmoq: biror narsaning haroratini oshirmoq.

a.q: Prices for fresh fruit and vegetables in the local market increased rapidly this week.
a.explain: go up — koʻtarilmoq: narx yoki miqdorning oshishi.

a.q: We must protect endangered wild animals and help them survive in their natural habitats.
a.explain: look after — gʻamxoʻrlik qilmoq: biror kishi yoki narsani asrab-avaylamoq.

a.q: Our kitchen milk supply finished completely, so I need to go to the shop now.
a.explain: run out — tugab qolmoq: zaxiraning oxiriga yetib qolishi.

a.q: We decided to postpone our school camping trip until next weekend because of heavy rain.
a.explain: put something off — kechiktirmoq: ishni keyingi vaqtga surmoq.

a.q: The dark grey sky above Tashkent started to produce heavy water drops falling steadily onto the ground.
a.explain: rain — yomg'ir: osmondan tushayotgan suv tomchilari
